Attacker plants <script> payload in a comment field, URL parameter, or HTTP header that is stored or reflected to victim browsers. Script runs in the victim's session context, stealing cookies/tokens, redirecting to phishing pages, or performing actions as the victim.

Technical execution: Attacker initiates connection to 45.33.32.156:22 using tools like nmap/curl. The payload exploits the MySQL, Apache httpd, OpenSSH, nginx, ntpd service.

remediation.action: Sanitise all existing stored XSS payloads
remediation.detail: Scan database for stored script tags. Sanitise or remove malicious content. Invalidate all active sessions.

remediation.action: Implement Content-Security-Policy header
remediation.detail: Deploy strict CSP: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{random}'. This prevents inline script execution even if XSS exists.

remediation.action: Add output encoding to all rendering paths
remediation.detail: Use context-aware encoding (HTML entity for HTML context, JS encoding for JS context). Use proven libraries: DOMPurify (client), OWASP Java Encoder (server).

remediation.action: Set Secure/HttpOnly flags on all cookies
remediation.detail: All session cookies must have HttpOnly (prevents JS access) and Secure (HTTPS only) flags. Use SameSite=Strict to prevent CSRF.

remediation.action: Implement automated XSS testing
remediation.detail: Integrate DAST XSS scanning (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite) in CI/CD. Train developers on secure rendering practices.

remediation.action: Enable deep packet inspection for scanme.nmap.org
remediation.detail: Deploy Suricata/Zeek rules monitoring traffic to 45.33.32.156 on ports 22, 80, 123, 443, 3306, 9929, 31337. Run: `tcpdump -i any host 45.33.32.156 -w /var/log/pcap/threat.pcap`.

Technical execution: Attacker initiates connection to vulnhub.com:80 using tools like nmap/curl. The payload exploits the nginx, MongoDB, PostgreSQL service.

remediation.action: Apply vendor patch or disable vulnerable service
remediation.detail: Apply security patch immediately. If unavailable, disable or network-isolate the vulnerable service.

remediation.action: Enable OS-level exploit mitigations
remediation.detail: Verify ASLR (echo 2 > /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space), stack canaries (compile with -fstack-protector-all), and NX/DEP are enabled.

remediation.action: Recompile affected software with security flags
remediation.detail: Recompile with: -fstack-protector-all -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -Wformat -Werror=format-security -pie -fPIE -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now.

remediation.action: Deploy network-level filtering for known exploit patterns
remediation.detail: Configure IPS signatures to detect oversized payloads and known shellcode patterns for the vulnerable service.

remediation.action: Migrate to memory-safe language for critical components
remediation.detail: Evaluate Rust or Go rewrites for security-critical network-facing components. Establish memory safety review process.

remediation.action: Enable deep packet inspection for vulnhub.com
remediation.detail: Deploy Suricata/Zeek rules monitoring traffic to vulnhub.com on ports 80, 443, 5432, 8080, 8443, 27017. Run: `tcpdump -i any host vulnhub.com -w /var/log/pcap/threat.pcap`.
